rule_text.R1: Contains a CivicDesk personal ID (CDID- followed by 6 digits). Ticket numbers (TKT- plus 5 digits) are fine.
rule_text.R2: Cites a circular that is not on the approved list (approved: Circular 12 of 2025, Circular 7 of 2026).
rule_text.R3: Says CivicDesk has reset or will reset a password, or has unlocked or will unlock an account. Saying a staff member will review a request is fine.
rule_text.R4: Tells an applicant they are hired, selected, shortlisted or ranked. Saying an application was received and a person will review it is fine.
